verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair axis for a cloud file-storage product, since comparable storage products can be self-hosted. Nothing in the evidence shows Google Drive offers a self-hostable or on-premises deployment: the docs describe only Google-hosted APIs and storage plans. Community mentions of rclone backups to S3 or local disk are user-side data-export workarounds, not self-hosting the product, and earn no credit.
